options.misconception: confuses "Automatically stimulative" with the correct "Contractionary or neutral, cooling the economy"

options.text: Contractionary or neutral, cooling the economy

options.misconception: selects "Expansionary" instead of "Contractionary or neutral, cooling the economy"

questions.explanation: For a deficits and surpluses question like this, the governing rule is: Surplus withdraws demand. Applying it makes "Contractionary or neutral, cooling the economy" correct. The alternative "Automatically stimulative" is wrong because it confuses "Automatically stimulative" with the correct "Contractionary or neutral, cooling the economy".
